about.h1-1: Truck it. Store it. Transload it.
about.h1-2: Stage it. Handle it. Deliver it.
about.span-1: From everyday freight to complex project cargo, our goal is simple: make logistics easier for our customers.
about.span-2: If you're looking for a transportation and logistics partner in the Pacific Northwest that is willing to think beyond the standard solution, welcome to Sky City.

p: From the ports to the final destination, Sky City provides dependable transportation solutions backed by our own assets and experienced operations team. Our capabilities include port drayage, local and regional transportation, flatbed, over-the-road service, oversized and overweight freight, and specialized project moves.
Whether it's a single container or an ongoing program, our team is built to respond quickly, communicate clearly, and keep freight moving.
Our 100,000-square-foot Sumner, Washington facility provides flexible warehousing, cross-dock and transloading solutions for both food-grade and general commodities.

With 36 dock doors, ramp access, secure parking and reefer plug capabilities, our facility is equipped to support everything from traditional palletized freight to floor-loaded containers, short- and long-term storage, container transfers, and specialized cargo.
Our team understands that not every project fits into a standard warehouse model. We work with our customers to develop solutions around the freight, not the other way around.
Sky City has expanded our capabilities to provide comprehensive breakbulk and project cargo logistics throughout the Pacific Northwest.

Our team can support oversized and out-of-gauge cargo, overweight transloads, open-top container transloading, top and crane flips, heavy and specialized freight, project staging, flatbed transportation, container stripping and loading, and other non-standard cargo requirements.

With access to both our Sumner facility and our 5-acre secured yard in the Port of Tacoma area, we have the space, equipment and transportation resources to support complex cargo from port arrival through final delivery.
Our proximity to the Ports of Tacoma and Seattle allows Sky City to provide an integrated solution for importers, exporters, freight forwarders, NVOCCs, ocean carriers and project cargo customers.
Services include drayage, container storage, transloading, cross-docking, empty container storage, overweight cargo handling and coordinated transportation, all managed through one team.

When a shipment requires resources beyond our own assets, Sky City Logistics extends our reach through our brokerage network. This allows us to provide additional capacity and transportation solutions while maintaining the responsive service and communication our customers expect from Sky City.

about.header-h2: Driven by Performance. Powered by Partnership.

content.p_1: Sky City Trucking is a family-owned, Christian-valued 3PL provider based in the Pacific Northwest, delivering nationwide transportation, warehousing, and logistics solutions with integrity, reliability, and service you can count on.
content.p_2: Our diverse capabilities allow us to support every stage of the supply chain, from port drayage and transportation to warehousing, transloading, heavy haul, container storage, and final-mile delivery. With more than 100,000 square feet of food-grade certified and general commodity warehouse space, along with a 5-acre secured yard in the Port of Tacoma area, Sky City is equipped to handle everything from everyday freight to oversized, specialized, and complex cargo.
content.p_3: We provide a true end-to-end logistics solution, seamlessly coordinating transportation, transloading, warehousing, inventory management, and final delivery through one experienced team.
content.p_4: What truly sets Sky City apart is our customer-driven approach. Built on Christian values, we believe in doing business with integrity, treating people with respect, communicating openly, and building relationships that last. Our team provides proactive communication and real-time visibility throughout the transportation process because we believe logistics should be simple, transparent, and dependable.
content.p_5: At Sky City Trucking, we don't just move freight, we build partnerships. By combining industry expertise, flexible solutions, and exceptional customer service, we go beyond simply getting the job done. We become an extension of our customers' teams and a logistics partner they can depend on.

services.header-span: From port to warehouse to final delivery, Sky City Trucking provides integrated transportation, warehousing, transloading, and specialized cargo solutions throughout the Pacific Northwest and nationwide. Our combination of asset-based transportation, warehouse capacity, secured yard space, specialized equipment, and an experienced logistics team allows us to manage both everyday freight and complex projects from start to finish.

intro: Strategically positioned to serve the Ports of Tacoma and Seattle, Sky City provides dependable port drayage and container solutions designed to keep import and export freight moving efficiently.

intro: Not every shipment fits neatly on a pallet—and that's where Sky City shines.

outro: From a single specialized shipment to a multi-container project, our operations team coordinates each stage to keep complex freight moving safely and efficiently.
